priorityList: Interrupt with Mind Freeze whenever possible.
Cast Remorseless Winter on cooldown if there are multiple targets or if Gathering Storm is talented.
Cast Pillar of Frost on cooldown, ensuring you have resources available to spend during its window.
Cast Breath of Sindragosa while Pillar of Frost is active and your Runic Power is at least 60.
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury at the very end of Pillar of Frost or during Breath of Sindragosa to maximize buff snapshots.
Cast Howling Blast if you have a Rime proc or if Frost Fever is not ticking on your targets.
Cast Frostscythe when Killing Machine is active if there are 3 or more targets.
Cast Obliterate when Killing Machine is active, targeting the enemy affected by the Trollbane slow if applicable.
Cast Glacial Advance to spend Runic Power in AoE situations, provided you are not pooling for an upcoming Breath of Sindragosa.
Cast Frost Strike to spend Runic Power on targets with 5 stacks of Razorice if Shattering Blade is talented.
Cast Empower Rune Weapon if you have fewer than 2 Runes or are low on Runic Power to sustain your rotation.
Cast Obliterate as your primary Rune spender when no Killing Machine procs are available.
Use combat potions and offensive trinkets during Pillar of Frost windows.
Use Anti-Magic Shell to generate Runic Power when taking predictable magic damage.
